summary: Installed and loaded the S009 launchd scheduler (com.algo.s009-paper), which had never actually been running: no plist under ~/Library/LaunchAgents, no launchd job, no cron entry -- since the last manual run on 2026-08-06 the paper ledger/state had gone stale (last_day stuck at 2026-08-05) while 4 real positions sat open on the dedicated Bybit-algo009 mainnet account with nothing auto-rebalancing them. Fixed a real bug this exposed in scripts/s009_tick.py: tick() defaulted its now parameter to timezone-aware UTC (datetime.now(timezone.utc)), but utils/trade_logger.py writes event timestamp fields as naive local time, so _has_event_today's since-cutoff comparison raised "can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes" on every idle tick once a heartbeat had already been logged for the day -- same failure signature as the two "S009 cycle subprocess exited non-zero" entries already in S009.log from 2026-08-03. Changed the default to naive local time (matching the logger and scripts/s007_tick.py's own default); this now parameter only affects heartbeat dedup/log-file day-naming, not the actual UTC trading-day boundary (_expected_last_closed_day() is independent of it). Added tests/scripts/test_s009_tick.py (regression test replays the exact two-consecutive-idle-ticks crash, plus branch coverage for the needs-cycle/timeout/nonzero-exit/state-did-not-advance paths, mirroring tests/scripts/test_s007_tick.py's structure). Per explicit user confirmation, also switched deployment/com.algo.s009-paper.plist from --broker off (shadow-only) to --broker execute --allow-mainnet, so the scheduler now auto-rebalances the real mainnet book daily; verified via BybitExec.positions()/wallet_equity() (read-only) that the reload itself placed no orders.

Documentation audit and Confluence migration: moved the S004 passport + E0-E11 experiments log (docs/STRATEGY_S004.md, docs/EXPERIMENTS.md) and the gap-fade research handoff (docs/HANDOFF_GAP_FADE_RESEARCH.md, previously untracked) to Confluence pages under Strategies (ids 10944530, 11042817), leaving English pointer stubs in the repo. Fixed stale claims: README live preset WORKING_S007 -> WORKING_S007_LIQFLOOR and outdated "S007 backtests not mirrored" note, expanded runner/docs lists; bot/S007_README.md preset BASELINE_S007 -> WORKING_S007_LIQFLOOR; deployment/schedule.yml and scripts/fetch_deribit_snapshot.py comments "S012 candidate" -> S013 (Deribit strangle was renumbered when S012 went to cross-sectional momentum). Confluence Strategies page updated to v7 (S004 link + pre-registry candidates section). Known drift left for consent: .claude/skills/strategy-lifecycle/SKILL.md line 56 still names the moved docs as live.

Added a shared Redis to the compose stack, reachable from every job-run worker container. docker-compose.yml: new redis service (redis:7.4.1-alpine, --appendonly yes --appendfsync everysec --maxmemory 512mb --maxmemory-policy noeviction, named volume redis-data, healthcheck redis-cli ping); new top-level network algo with an explicit name: algo (NOT project-prefixed) so the Ofelia job-run label can attach ephemeral worker containers -- which are created straight through the podman socket, not as compose services -- to it by literal name; added ofelia.job-run.dispatch.network: algo and REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379 to the job-run environment array; worker (build-only) service also put on algo for documentation. Redis is deliberately NOT published to the host (Anton chose internal-network-only, no auth): only compose containers reach it, a host process (the manually-run webapp) cannot -- utils/redis_client.is_available() returns False there. One instance serves two roles: STATE_DB=0 for durable shared state / distributed locks / pub-sub, CACHE_DB=1 for the market-data cache still parked in docs/DEV_PLANS.md (cache keys carry their own TTL; server is noeviction). New utils/redis_client.py: redis_url() (REDIS_URL env, else DEFAULT_REDIS_URL redis://redis:6379), lru_cached get_client(db, *, decode_responses) with 2s connect/op timeouts, never-raises is_available(); guards a missing redis package (in requirements-docker.txt, added redis==5.2.1; also requirements.txt redis>=5.2,<6). 4 tests in tests/utils/test_redis_client.py (URL resolution, is_available False+no-raise without a server). DEV_PLANS.md updated: replaced the deferred market-data-cache bullet with Shared-Redis + cache-infra-ready + scheduler-lock-migration-candidate bullets. NOT done: wiring get_m1 read-through, migrating scripts/scheduler_tick.py data/.scheduler_locks to a Redis lock. Worker image (algo-worker:latest) must be rebuilt to pick up the redis dependency. Not run live (podman machine not reachable from this session); compose YAML + label JSON arrays validated, full tests/utils green (18 passed).
